description: This file defines the DistributedPub interface, which provides methods for publishing messages and managing topics in a distributed publish-subscribe system using Akka actors.

classes.name: DistributedPub
classes.description: A Java interface for a distributed publisher in a pub/sub system, parameterized by message type T, providing methods to get publisher references, wrap messages, publish messages, and create new instances with topic extractors.

methods.name: getPublisher
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef that acts as the publisher to which messages are sent.

methods.name: wrapForPublication
methods.description: Wraps the message into an envelope to prepare it for publication.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message with a specified sender. Default method that sends the wrapped message to the publisher actor.

methods.name: withTopicExtractor
methods.description: Creates a new DistributedPub instance with a different topic extractor.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DistributedPub with a given pub supervisor ActorRef and topic extractor.
